clue.text: Workers added note about unwanted furniture

indicators.note: about means one piece goes around the other, so the added note wraps the furniture

parts.note: PS, postscript, is a note added at the end of a letter
lumber is disused furniture and junk stored away

explanation.surface: Tradesmen scribble a note about some old furniture nobody wants.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unwanted furniture' is lumber, the old junk stored in a lumber room; 'about' wraps the postscript around it.
explanation.definitionFit: Plumbers are tradesmen who fit pipes, so they are a kind of worker.

clue.text: Light on wild tree by Welsh town

parts.note: a lamp is a light

indicators.note: wild signals the letters of tree are scrambled

explanation.surface: A lamp hangs on a wild tree beside a town in Wales.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wild' rearranges TREE into ETER. Lampeter is a small university town in west Wales.
explanation.definitionFit: Lampeter is a market town in Ceredigion, west Wales.

clue.text: Prosaic affair-cricket side has to perform

parts.note: a matter is an affair or business
the off side is one half of a cricket field
to act is to perform

explanation.surface: A dull cricket match where one side must put on a show.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the field divides into the off side and the leg side.
explanation.definitionFit: Unimaginative, plain and down to earth, as a prosaic person is.

clue.text: Heavenly anaesthetic — a brew of ale!

parts.note: ether was an early general anaesthetic

indicators.note: a brew of something mixes it up, so the letters of ale are scrambled

explanation.surface: Beer as a divine painkiller.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brew of' rearranges ALE into EAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Ethereal means airy and otherworldly, as if from the heavens.

clue.text: Hundreds upset over his writing of divisions in the Church

indicators.note: upset in a down clue turns the letters upside down, reading them backwards

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, so hundreds are Cs
MS, manuscript, is a piece of writing

explanation.surface: Many people object to a priest's writings about church splits.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' turns CS into SC.
explanation.definitionFit: A schism is a split in a religious body into rival factions.

clue.text: The Asian Doctor Long treated?

parts.note: MO is a medical officer, a doctor

indicators.note: treated signals the letters of long are worked on and rearranged

explanation.surface: An Asian physician called Long is given treatment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'treated' rearranges LONG into NGOL.
explanation.definitionFit: The Mongols are a people of central Asia.

clue.text: Car of note isn't finished

indicators.note: isn't finished means the last letter is lopped off

parts.note: a minim is a musical note, a half note

explanation.surface: A famous car still under construction.
explanation.walkthrough: 'isn't finished' drops the last M of MINIM.
explanation.definitionFit: The Mini is a small British car first made in 1959.

clue.text: Woman is a beast about the tennis fixture

indicators.note: about means the beast goes around the tennis item

parts.note: a brute is a beast
the net is fixed across the middle of a tennis court

explanation.surface: A woman behaves brutishly over a tennis match.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fixture' suggests a match, but it is the net fixed across the court.
explanation.definitionFit: A brunette is a woman with dark brown hair.

clue.text: He takes the stakes and makes childish complaint about one backer

parts.note: croup is a throat infection mostly suffered by young children
I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: backer is read as 'turned back', so the word for about is written backwards

parts.note: re means about, concerning

explanation.surface: A gambling official grumbles like a child about the man backing him.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backer' turns the word for about round. A croupier originally meant one who rode behind on a horse's croup, so the surface has a buried pun.
explanation.definitionFit: A croupier is the casino employee who collects and pays out bets at the gaming table.

clue.text: Fail to do something after an order

indicators.note: after places the word for something behind the order

parts.note: OM is the Order of Merit, a British honour
it can stand for an unnamed something

explanation.surface: Someone neglects a task once they have been given an order.
explanation.walkthrough: The Order of Merit is a British honour, abbreviated OM; 'after' puts the pronoun behind it.
explanation.definitionFit: To leave something out or neglect it is to fail to do it.

clue.text: WIster's work, features one of Thackeray's Americans

definitions.meaning: Owen Wister's 1902 Western novel about a cowboy from the Old Dominion state
Thackeray wrote a novel about two brothers from colonial Virginia, so one of them is a Virginian

explanation.walkthrough: The scan prints 'Wister's'; the OCR capital I is a misreading. Owen Wister was an American novelist; Thackeray's The Virginians follows the Warrington twins.
explanation.definitionFit: Wister's cowboy novel bears this title, and each of Thackeray's Warrington brothers is a native of Virginia.

clue.text: Manhattan's Dutch-style town is now in Guyana

definitions.meaning: the Dutch colonial settlement on Manhattan later renamed New York
a town of that name stands on the Berbice River in Guyana today

explanation.surface: A Dutch settlement on Manhattan has moved to South America.
explanation.definitionFit: The Dutch colony on Manhattan bore this name before the English took it, and a Guyanese town still carries it.

clue.text: Author Laurence is back, we hear

indicators.note: we hear says the clue gives a word by its sound, not its spelling

parts.note: the stern is the back of a ship

explanation.surface: A novelist is said to have returned.
explanation.walkthrough: Laurence Sterne wrote Tristram Shandy; his surname is pronounced like the word for a ship's rear.
explanation.definitionFit: Laurence Sterne was the eighteenth-century novelist of Tristram Shandy.

clue.text: Unusual work in Milton, but out on this plant

indicators.note: in puts the rearranged word inside the shortened name
out says the word on is removed from the poet's name

explanation.walkthrough: 'but out on' takes ON from MILTON, leaving MILT; 'Unusual' rearranges WORK into KWOR, which goes 'in' MILT.
explanation.definitionFit: Milkwort is a small wildflower once thought to boost cows' milk yield.

clue.text: In favour of a smoother outline

parts.note: pro means in favour of
a file is a tool for smoothing rough edges

explanation.surface: Someone backs a gentler shape.
explanation.definitionFit: A profile is a side view or silhouette, the outline of a shape.

clue.text: Carried by Minstrel Boy to give to the sentry ?

definitions.text: Carried by Minstrel Boy to give to the sentry ?

parts.words: Carried by Minstrel Boy to give to the sentry
parts.note: a secret word that a messenger brings to a guard to be let through

explanation.walkthrough: A wandering minstrel had to be let through sentries, so he carried the secret word to speak at the gate.
explanation.definitionFit: A secret word spoken to a sentry gains admission past the guard.

clue.text: Enliven mount carrying foreign friend back

indicators.note: back at the end turns the whole construction round so it reads in reverse
carrying means the mountain holds the friend inside it

explanation.walkthrough: 'carrying' puts the friend inside the volcano, giving ETAMINA, and 'back' reverses all of that.
explanation.definitionFit: To animate something is to bring it to life or make it lively.

clue.text: Witch seen close to Gath settlement

indicators.note: settlement suggests settling the letters of Gath into a new order

explanation.surface: A witch spotted near a biblical city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'settlement' rearranges GATH into THAG. Gath was a Philistine city in the Bible. The grid needs N?G?T??G, which the old answer NEGATING does not fit as (5-3).

clue.text: Isn't he a piano composer, or player?

parts.note: p is the musical abbreviation for piano, softly

clue.text: Vessel might be given letters in middle of crossing

clue.text: Neat American poker hand

definitions.meaning: a neat drink is served without water or mixer
five cards in sequence form this hand in poker

explanation.surface: A tidy American holds a hand of cards.
explanation.definitionFit: Spirits taken undiluted are served this way, and a run of five consecutive cards is the poker hand of that name.

clue.text: Composer of Beethoven's description ?

clue.text: Deduce that it needs pluck?

clue.text: German artist suggests the arrival of Spring

clue.text: A number content to turn in early ?

clue.text: Legislature appears in paper — endlessly

clue.text: Redhead meeting irregular soldiers
